About

Join local ghost expert, The Curator (of Wakefield and Pontefract Ghost Walk fame), and delve into the spooky history of the Nostell estate.


Enjoy a spooky walk through the parkland and gardens before returning to the front of the house to conclude the tour.


Each participant will receive a handheld prop lantern to help uncover ghostly sightings along the way.


Ghost sightings not guaranteed.


The Nostell Ghost Walks are suitable for ages 12+ and under 16s must be accompanied by an adult.


Please dress for the weather and wear suitable footwear, as paths may be uneven, wet or muddy. Staff will have torches, but feel free to bring your own additional lighting.


Access facilities

  • Accessible Car Parking
  • Accessible Toilet
  • Assistance Dogs Welcome
